minimax_h3_prompt_reference_doc.text:
How the reference pictures align with the target video — <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) aligns with the 5.00-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a close shot begins with a plausible preceding state where the group is at the base of the mountain, then the camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the entire group, including the subjects visible in <Picture 1>, steadily ascend the mountain path. The camera tracks the group from behind and slightly above, maintaining a consistent framing that gradually reveals more of the rugged terrain and the increasing elevation as they climb. By the end of the shot, the group reaches the exact position, posture, and composition established by <Picture 1> at the 5.00-second mark, with everyone continuing their upward movement toward the summit.

overall_soundscape: Steady footsteps crunch on the gravelly mountain path, accompanied by the soft rustle of wind through the trees and the occasional distant bird call. The breathing of the group is audible, with a slight increase in rate as they climb higher.

non_diegetic_music: A low, atmospheric drone with a slow, steady rhythm, gradually increasing in volume as the group ascends, creating a sense of anticipation and effort.
